job.title: Health Care Assistant
job.description:
Fire Healthcare | Flexible Agency Opportunities

Fire Healthcare is currently recruiting experienced and dedicated Healthcare Assistants to support one of our established clients across multiple locations throughout the UK.

We are looking for compassionate, reliable and professional Healthcare Assistants who are passionate about delivering high-quality care and support to individuals with varying needs.
We have opportunities available across the following locations:

Locations:

  • Warrington
  • Bolton
  • Liverpool
  • Salford
  • Ashton-under-Lyne
  • Walsall
  • Studley
  • Kettering
  • Rushden
  • Suffolk
  • Bedfordshire

Working Hours
  • Approximately 300 hours per week available across the contract.
  • Flexible agency shifts and working opportunities.

Required Training & Competencies
Candidates MUST hold relevant mandatory care training & Practical Training Certificates & DBS On the Update Service.
Additional specialist training requirements apply depending on location:
  • PEG Feeding: Required for Warrington, Bolton, Liverpool and Ashton-under-Lyne.
  • Enteral Feeding: Required for Ashton-under-Lyne only.
What We Are Looking For
  • Previous experience working as a Support Worker/Healthcare Assistant.
  • Experience supporting individuals with complex care needs.
  • Relevant mandatory training certificates.
  • Specialist PEG Feeding / Enteral Feeding training where applicable.
  • A reliable, professional and compassionate approach.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A commitment to delivering person-centred care.

Why Work With Fire Healthcare?
  • Access to flexible agency opportunities.
  • Opportunities across multiple locations.
  • Support from a dedicated recruitment team.
  • Opportunities to work with an established care provider.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced Support Worker or Healthcare Assistant looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you.
Apply through Indeed today, or contact the Fire Healthcare recruitment team to discuss available opportunities.
Applicants must be fully complaint by end of day 25th November.

Fire Healthcare – Providing quality people, quality care and flexible staffing solutions.

Requirements
Required: You need clear spoken and written English, effective communication skills, basic IT ability and the care and attention needed to follow care plans and record information accurately. You should be able to support people respectfully with daily activities and work reliably with colleagues. Preferred: Experience in a care home or home care setting, and driving ability, would be useful strengths for this role.

job.description:
Are you a chef/cook looking for a great work life balance and a lovely working environment? If so, this could be the perfect role for you!

We're recruiting for a chef/cook to join a welcoming café operation on a Monday to Friday daytime basis, preparing fresh, delicious food for breakfast and lunch in a friendly, community-focused environment.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a passionate chef who enjoys cooking fresh food, delivering excellent customer service and being part of a team that makes a positive impact.

Working alongside the Chef Manager, you'll help deliver a varied menu of freshly prepared breakfasts, light lunches, cakes and snacks. As well as being hands-on in the kitchen, you'll help maintain high standards of food quality, hygiene and presentation while contributing ideas to menus.

  • Sociable hours working Monday to Friday with no evenings or weekend working!
  • Free onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing Facilities and Support
  • A caring & supportive workplace
  • Access to retailer discounts + more!


About You

We're looking for a motivated and reliable chef who takes pride in producing great food and enjoys working as part of a team.

  • Experience cooking and baking in a fresh food café, restaurant, pub, canteen or similar environment.

  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Food Safety certificate

  • The ability to work independently, manage your time effectively and remain organised during busy periods.
  • A positive, caring and flexible approach to working with others.

job.title: Registered General Nurse (RGN) – Care Home
job.description:
Registered General Nurse (RGN) – Care Home
Location: South West London
Employer: Fire Group
Job Type: Flexible / Shift Work
Pay: Competitive rates ( 25.00 – 27.00 ) negotiable depending on experience

About the Role
Fire Group is recruiting experienced and dedicated Registered General Nurses (RGNs) to work within care homes across South West London.
We are looking for compassionate, reliable and professional nurses committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred care.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver safe, effective and person-centred nursing care.
  • Administer medication safely and accurately in line with care home policies.
  • Complete medication rounds and maintain accurate medication records.
  • Monitor residents' health and respond appropriately to changes in condition.
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation and care plans.
  • Support and supervise care staff where required.
  • Liaise with GPs, healthcare professionals, residents and families.
  • Follow safeguarding and infection prevention procedures.
  • Promote residents' dignity, respect and independence.

﻿Essential Requirements

Applicants must have:
  • A valid and active NMC PIN.
  • Relevant nursing qualifications and registration.
  • A valid Enhanced DBS registered on the Update Service.
  • Relevant medication management training and competency.
  • Valid and up-to-date mandatory training certificates, or be willing to complete refresher training where required.
  • Previous nursing experience, preferably within a care home environment.
  • A good understanding of safeguarding and clinical care standards.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility and willingness to work a variety of shift patterns.
What Fire Group Offers
  • Competitive and negotiable pay rates.
  • Flexible shift opportunities.
  • Opportunities within established care home settings.
  • Ongoing support from the Fire Group team.
  • A straightforward compliance and onboarding process.
How to Apply
If you are a qualified Registered Nurse with an active NMC PIN, an Enhanced DBS on the Update Service and the relevant experience, we would love to hear from you.
Please apply through Indeed with an up-to-date CV.
Suitable applicants will be contacted to discuss opportunities and complete our compliance process.
Fire Group – Supporting Care Through Quality Staffing.

job.title: Chef de Partie
job.description:
Chef de Partie – Term Time Only | 25 Hours per Week | Daytimes | Near Winchester, Hampshire

Are you an experienced Chef de Partie / Chef looking for a role that offers an excellent work-life balance? We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established education provider for a talented chef to join a busy and professional catering team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a friendly, professional, high-volume kitchen, preparing fresh, nutritious meals for a large student and staff community. You'll have responsibility for your own kitchen section while working alongside an experienced leadership team in a supportive environment that values quality, teamwork and professional development.

What's in it for You?

  • Excellent work-life balance with term-time only working.
  • Daytime working wth no late nights or split shifts.
  • Permanent role within a stable and supportive organisation.
  • Friendly and inclusive working environment.
  • Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
  • A comprehensive employee benefits package and wellbeing initiatives

The Role

As Chef de Partie, you'll take ownership of a designated kitchen section, ensuring food is prepared, cooked and presented to a consistently high standard. Working closely with the Head Chef and Second Chef, you'll help deliver a varied menu for daily service while maintaining exceptional food safety and hygiene standards.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working with fresh ingredients in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Working Hours

  • 25 hours per week
  • 4 days per week
  • Daytimes
  • Term Time Only – 30 weeks per year

About You

To be successful, you'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, experienced Demi Chef de Partie or similar
  • NVQ Level 2 in Professional Cookery (or equivalent).
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene Certificate.
  • Experience working in a busy, high-volume catering environment.
  • Strong knowledge of food safety, HACCP and allergen management.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • A positive attitude with the ability to motivate and support colleagues.
  • A genuine passion for producing fresh, nutritious food.

This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate Chef de Partie who is looking to step into a rewarding role with sociable hours while continuing to work with fresh food in a professional kitchen.

Apply today to find out more about this fantastic opportunity.

job.title: Pastry Chef
job.description:
Pastry Chef
Up to £40,000 + Service Charge | Excellent Benefits

The Role

Our client, a highly regarded high end Rosette restaurant operation, is looking for a passionate and creative Pastry Chef to join their established kitchen team.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Pastry Chef to take responsibility for the pastry section within a quality operation, producing exceptional plated desserts, afternoon teas and pastry work using fresh, seasonal produce.

Working closely with the Executive Chef, you will have genuine creative input into the menus, with the opportunity to develop new ideas and put your own stamp on the pastry offering.

The kitchen is modern, spacious and exceptionally well equipped, providing an excellent environment in which to work.

About You

We are looking for a Pastry Chef with a strong background in a high-end restaurant or hotel environment, ideally with multiple rosette experience, who is passionate about their craft and takes real pride in producing exceptional pastry. You can be a pastry chef de partie looking to learn and progress or a more senior pastry chef looking for their next opportunity.

You will ideally:

  • Have strong experience leading a pastry section within a high quality restaurant or hotel
  • Have excellent plated dessert experience
  • Have strong pastry skills and chocolate work experience
  • Be creative, with a genuine interest in developing new desserts and ideas
  • Have excellent attention to detail and high standards of presentation
  • Be organised, clean and tidy in your approach
  • Have a good understanding of allergens and food safety
  • Be a confident communicator and a strong team player
  • Be passionate, motivated and enthusiastic about your trade
  • Enjoy developing junior members of the team
  • Be keen to grow and develop within the business

This is a great opportunity for a talented Pastry Chef who wants more than simply producing an established menu. You will have the opportunity to work closely with an experienced Executive Chef, contribute your own ideas and help shape the future pastry offering.

What's on Offer?

  • Up to £40,000 salary DOE
  • £300-£400 per month service charge
  • Free parking
  • Staff meals
  • Various company discounts
  • Modern, well-equipped kitchen
  • Excellent working environment
  • Genuine opportunity for career development
  • Creative input into menus

Due to the location, applicants will need their own transport.

If you are a talented Pastry Chef looking for a new challenge within a quality high end operation, where your creativity and ideas will be valued, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.

job.title: Chef de Partie
job.description:
Chef de Partie - DAY TIMES

Due to our client's success, they are looking for a strong, fresh-food-passionate chef de partie. This is an excellent opportunity for a chef who enjoys working with fresh, quality ingredients in a welcoming, food-led environment, without the demands of a traditional late-night restaurant kitchen.

Our client's business offers a varied food operation, with breakfast, lunch, seasonal dishes and freshly prepared deli favourites. They take pride in quality, consistency and creating great food using local and national suppliers.

The Role

Working as part of a small, dedicated kitchen team, your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing and cooking fresh dishes to a consistently high standard.
  • Taking responsibility for your section and ensuring smooth service.
  • Supporting breakfast and lunch service.
  • Preparing homemade soups, salads, light meals and seasonal specials.
  • Maintaining excellent standards of food hygiene, cleanliness and food safety.
  • Managing stock, minimising waste and ensuring ingredients are stored correctly.
  • Contributing ideas for menus and daily specials.
  • Working collaboratively with the wider team to deliver an excellent customer experience.
  • The opportunity to work with quality ingredients in an independent food business.
  • A varied role with scope to contribute ideas and develop your skills.
  • A friendly, close-knit working environment.
  • Predominantly daytime hours.
  • A chance to be part of a business that values quality food and customer service.

Working Hours
Predominantly daytime working hours, making this an attractive opportunity for a chef seeking a better work-life balance. The business operates mainly during the day, although some flexibility may be required to support occasional evening services or special events.

Due to the location, you must have your own transport, as public transport is very limited.

The Package

  • Starting Salary of £33,000 per year
  • Tips and Service
  • Free Parking
  • Plus other benefits

Apply Now: If you are a motivated chef who enjoys fresh food, takes pride in your work and is looking for a predominantly daytime role, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and a brief introduction outlining your kitchen experience and availability.
